title: Personal Training Packages: which tiers are eligible for the loyalty bonus session, and the one-per-package limit
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states the tier-eligibility and one-per-package basis for the complimentary loyalty bonus session.

## Rule
Only a package on a tier for which the loyalty bonus session is eligible may be owed one. A package that has already had a bonus session credited to it is not owed a further one; the loyalty bonus session is owed on a given package at most once.

## Points of judgement
- If the package's own tier is eligible for the loyalty bonus session and no bonus session has yet been credited to that package, this condition of the loyalty bonus is satisfied.
- If the package's own tier is not eligible for the loyalty bonus session, no bonus session is owed on that package regardless of any other condition.
- If a bonus session has already been credited to the package, no further bonus session is owed on that package, even if the tier is eligible.
This check looks only at the specific package's own tier and its own prior bonus-grant history; a member's other open packages, and any bonus sessions credited to those other packages, play no part in this determination.
